content_blocks.text: In the quiet town of Millbrook, nestled between rolling hills and whispering woods, the legacy of Dr. Eliza Green continues to inspire. For decades, Dr. Green has been a beacon of hope for those suffering from rare neurological disorders. Her groundbreaking work, funded by the Millbrook Medical Foundation, has not only brought comfort to patients but also paved the way for future research. This year, the foundation is celebrating its 25th anniversary, honoring Dr. Green’s enduring commitment to medical advancement.
